title: Labels for the Hut

intro.speaker: silas
intro.text: Winter on the mountain is long and dark. I like everything in my hut labelled, so I can find it by candlelight.

intro.speaker: silas
intro.text: My old labels have faded. Will you write me new ones?

steps.speaker: silas
steps.prompt: Listen to the word. Which sounds do you hear? Put each letter in its place.

older.prompt: Listen to the word. Which sounds do you hear, first to last? Find each letter in the box.

feedback.wrong: Listen again: {word}. That sound goes somewhere else.
feedback.all_good: Every label new and clear. I'll find my mug in the dark now!

outro.speaker: silas
outro.text: Thank you, friend. A tidy hut makes the long winter evenings cosy.

journal_line: I wrote new labels for Mr. Silas's hut.
